lead: A selection of the best guided-tour companies with official guides in the Comunitat Valenciana. Itinerary, language, schedule and pace: you decide everything.
Four leading companies with distinct specialities and offerings for groups and private tours.

items.title: Turiart
items.subtitle: Spanish · Valencian · English · Italian · German · French · Max. 10 people on a private tour
items.body: A company specialising in cultural and family tourism in the Comunitat Valenciana. It offers regular guided visits and tailor-made private tours, and manages complete tourist and cultural programmes — including arranging guides, transport, accommodation, restaurants and museum admissions — so that visitors enjoy a complete experience. Its private tours are fully customisable: the client chooses the date, the time (between 8:00 and 20:00), the meeting point, the language and the number of hours. Among its most popular routes are “Essential Valencia and its World Heritage Sites”, the “Valencia Family Tour” (with games and activities for children aged 4 to 10), “Legends and mysteries by Valencian moonlight” and the historical route “Valencia, Capital of the Republic”, which includes a visit to a Civil War air-raid shelter.

items.title: Guiding Architects Valencia
items.subtitle: English · German · Spanish · French · Architects as guides · Members of the international Guiding Architects network
items.body: A company founded in 2009 by the architect Boris Strzelczyk, a member of Guiding Architects, the prestigious international network of architecture guides present in more than 45 cities worldwide. The whole team is made up of architects and urban experts who live and work in the Comunitat Valenciana. Its clients are groups and professionals — architecture universities, studios, companies, politicians — who want to explore Valencia through the expert eye of an architect. It organises fully customised themed routes on architecture, urban planning and landscape, as well as lectures and professional meetings. It has native German-speaking guides and offers tours in English, French and Spanish. It also arranges transport, admissions and restaurant bookings for multi-day programmes.

items.title: Discovering Valencia
items.subtitle: Spanish · English · 100% accessible tours · Excursions with private transport · MICE · Organised groups
items.body: A company of official tourist guides specialising in private tours of Valencia and private excursions in the surrounding area with transport included. In the city, it offers a walking tour of the historic centre from €15, fully accessible for people with reduced mobility. For the surrounding area, it organises full-day excursions (8 hours) to the Caves of San José, Sagunto, Xàtiva, Peñíscola, Guadalest, the wineries of Utiel-Requena, Teruel and many other destinations, all with an official guide and private transport. The transport is adapted to the group: car, people carrier, coach, limousine or classic car. For MICE clients it offers multiple VIP coaches with company logos.

items.title: Valencia & Go
items.subtitle: Valencian · Spanish · English · French · German · Italian · Polish · Romanian · Small groups
items.body: A private-tour company with an official guide dedicated exclusively to the client. Unlike group tours, its offering adapts completely to the visitor’s interests and pace, with several possible itineraries: the historical route through the centre starting at the Serranos Towers, the route around the exteriors of the City of Arts and Sciences, neighbourhood routes through Ruzafa, Cabanyal or Benimaclet, and themed tours with a Modernist, Baroque or contemporary focus. They also offer special prices for groups. One of its strengths is its very wide range of languages: Valencian, Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Polish and Romanian, among others.

blocks.title: Tips for booking a private tour in Valencia
items: Book at least 48–72 hours ahead in high season (March–October): official guides have busy diaries and the best ones fill up fast
For groups of more than 10 people, many operators have special group rates that work out cheaper than regular per-person tours
If you need a tour in an uncommon language (Dutch, Polish, Romanian, Japanese...), contact the operator in good time: the availability of guides in certain languages is limited
Private tours are ideal for special occasions: birthdays, marriage proposals, stag and hen parties, anniversaries or company celebrations
For excursions in the surrounding area (Albufera, Sagunto, Xàtiva, wineries), always book with private transport included: it is more comfortable and the price per person is reasonable for a group
With the Asociación de Guías Oficiales de la CV you can find a certified guide in any language and for any theme if the individual operators have no availability
